notes.title: New Upcoming Game: Mutagenesis
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543470/Mutagenesis/

ABOUT

In the future, people started to fight each other because of insufficient resources. This war has turned into a nuclear war and mankind has destroyed the world. After the nuclear war, some humans mutated into monsters. Other survivors must both manage limited resources and survive against mutated humans.

WHAT CAN YOU DO?


 Collect resources around the map and build your manufactory.
 Survive each wave of mutated humans!
 Survive against other factions or you can simply ally with them.
 Build and develop your base from wood, stone, gold, anti-radiation metal and more.
 Build defences like turret, minigun, rifles.
 Plant and grow different type of food.
 Craft, upgrade and improve wepons, structures.
 Research new inventions.
 Make an army.
 Capture refugees or prisoners and turn them to your side or sell them into slavery
 Dig through snow, weather storms, and disasters.
 Improve your diplomacy with others and trade with them.
 Be a leader for your community and solve their problems.
 Decide critical moments.
 Protect your bunker no mather what!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First major update is live! Here is some new features about new patch!


New Content


 3 more romance option added.
 5 different relationship endings.
 2 secret ending added.
 [spoiler] Now you can be with princess and heir to throne. [/spoiler]
 [spoiler] If you end with Merfit. You will have 1 secret reward.[/spoiler]
 Added 50 more levels to void.
 Added 25 new food recipes.
 Added 5 new drink recipes.
 Added 7 new items to marketplace.
 Now you can harvest fruits at dark woods.
 2 different fruits added.



Bug Fix

 Stuck on Finn's store fixed.
 Stuck while exiting void fixed.
 Save system stuck on bed fixed.
 Save system not saving fixed.
 Gold bugs when selling apple fixed.
 Running bug fixed.
 Day 24 event not triggering fixed.
 First event bug fixed.


What's Next?

[olist]
 Equippable items will be added soon. (Armor,Weapon)
 Enchantment will be added soon.
 Chemistry will be added next update.
 Character customization will be added next update.
[/olist]


You can always contact me, give ideas and report bugs. I will continue to improve the game as much as I can and add new content.

notes.title: 1.02 Patch
notes.content:
Hello Fallen Kingdom players. Here is the list of fixed bugs and improvements of 1.01 patch.
If you find a bug, please shere with me at steam discussion page or Discord server. We will fix it ASAP.

The Void
- Runing disabled in Void.
- The problem of not giving rewards when you get to each 5 level, has been fixed.
- Magiclands map changes.
- Solved the problem that the mouse cursor does not appear when you die in the void.


Game
- Save system has been fixed.
- Some UI bugs has been fixed.
- Quit buttons fixed.
- Inventory save bugs has been fixed.

Niafell
- Player bed has changed.
- Fixed stuck on bed after saving the game.
- When drinking at tavern, fixed respawn point after being drunk.
- The problem of not growing plants in the farming zone has been fixed
[spoiler]- Added 10 new dialogue.[/spoiler]
- Quests in guard tower bug has been fixed.

notes.title: Announcement 1.0
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone! ːcoolstar2022ː 

Welctome to the Fallen Kingdom's milestones and development blog. 

First of all, i would like to talk about a few miletones of the Fallen Kingdom.

 After release i'm planning to giveaway 20 steam keys on Fallen Kingdom's official Discord server. Join Discord
 Main story of Fallen Kingdom has 2 Parts. Part 1 will be released to everyone who owns the game. Part 2 will be announced more later.
 In several updates, 4 seasons will be added to the game. Contains 8 different seasonal events.
 More locations (Secret and magical places) will be added after several updates. 


Development Log

Fallen Kingdom is complex and open-ended RPG which comes with extraordinary gameplay features.
Little time left to complete full story.

v1.0

 Designed all day and night cycle with warm atmosphere.
 All locations are designed.
 All characters designed and can fully interactable.
 All Stores are filled with usable items.
 Equipment bar removed and replaced with quick menu.
 Save system completed.
 Fishing, Mining, Buy&Sell resources, Running business (Tavern Restaurant , Hotel) completed and ready to play.
 You will be able to define your own names for the businesses you bought.
 Steam achievements added to Steam.


You can follow official pages and get notify about latest news and special gifts!
